alt: 男子只顧伸手拿取木橋上的金幣，忽略腳前斷裂的橋板，身後朋友焦急地伸手提醒。
scene_prompt: An adult walker stares greedily at a bright heap of gold coins on an obviously rotten wooden footbridge and reaches both hands toward the treasure, neglecting a large visible break immediately under the next step. A concerned friend on solid ground reaches out to warn him, but his gaze is fixed solely on the coins. The danger is clear and consequence imminent without injury; no traps tutorial, no brands or written signs.
